mapper.select: SELECT gateway_id AS gatewayId,place_id AS placeId,source_address AS sourceAddress,center_address AS centerAddress,allowed_ip AS allowedIp,enabled FROM fire_gateway WHERE source_address=#{source} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE fire_gateway SET status_bits=#{bits},status_description=#{name},status_device_time=#{deviceTime} WHERE gateway_id=#{gatewayId} AND ((#{deviceTime} IS NOT NULL AND (status_device_time IS NULL OR status_device_time <= #{deviceTime})) OR status_bits IS NULL)
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO fire_host(gateway_id,system_type,system_address,name,status_bits,status_description,status_device_time,last_received_at,software_version,description) VALUES(#{gatewayId},#{systemType},#{systemAddress},#{hostName},#{bits},#{stateName},#{stateTime},#{receivedAt},#{version},#{description}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE status_bits=IF(VALUES(status_bits) IS NOT NULL AND (status_device_time IS NULL OR VALUES(status_device_time)>=status_device_time),VALUES(status_bits),status_bits), status_description=IF(VALUES(status_bits) IS NOT NULL AND (status_device_time IS NULL OR VALUES(status_device_time)>=status_device_time),VALUES(status_description),status_description), status_device_time=IF(VALUES(status_bits) IS NOT NULL AND (status_device_time IS NULL OR VALUES(status_device_time)>=status_device_time),VALUES(status_device_time),status_device_time), last_received_at=VALUES(last_received_at),software_version=COALESCE(VALUES(software_version),software_version), description=COALESCE(VALUES(description),description),update_time=NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT host_id AS hostId FROM fire_host WHERE gateway_id=#{gatewayId} AND system_type=#{systemType} AND system_address=#{systemAddress}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO fire_event(event_id,gateway_id,host_id,message_id,object_type,object_index,object_key,event_kind,name,device_time,received_at,clock_warning,details_json) VALUES(#{eventId},#{gatewayId},#{hostId},#{messageId},#{type},#{objectIndex},#{objectKey},#{kind},#{name},#{deviceTime},#{receivedAt},#{clockWarning},#{details}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE event_id=event_id
mapper.sql: FROM fire_gateway g JOIN fire_place p ON p.place_id=g.place_id
mapper.select: SELECT CAST(g.gateway_id AS CHAR) AS id,g.name,p.name AS placeName,CAST(p.place_id AS CHAR) AS placeId,g.model, g.source_address AS serial,g.allowed_ip AS peerIp,g.last_received_at AS lastSeen,g.status_description AS deviceStatus, g.status_bits AS statusBits,g.status_device_time AS deviceTime,'database' AS dataSource WHERE 1=1 AND g.gateway_id=#{id} ORDER BY g.gateway_id

SELECT CAST(h.host_id AS CHAR) AS id,h.name,p.name AS placeName,CAST(p.place_id AS CHAR) AS placeId, CAST(g.gateway_id AS CHAR) AS gatewayId,g.name AS gatewayName,g.source_address AS gatewayAddress, CONCAT(h.system_type,'/',h.system_address) AS serial,h.status_description AS deviceStatus,h.status_bits AS statusBits, h.status_device_time AS deviceTime,h.last_received_at AS lastSeen,h.software_version AS softwareVersion, h.description,'database' AS dataSource FROM fire_host h JOIN fire_gateway g ON h.gateway_id=g.gateway_id JOIN fire_place p ON p.place_id=g.place_id WHERE 1=1 AND h.host_id=#{id} ORDER BY h.host_id

SELECT e.event_id AS id,e.event_id AS code,e.name,e.event_kind AS kind, e.object_type AS objectType,e.object_key AS deviceId,'消控室主机' AS source, '设备记录' AS status,CAST(p.place_id AS CHAR) AS placeId,p.name AS placeName, CAST(g.gateway_id AS CHAR) AS gatewayId,g.name AS gatewayName,g.source_address AS gatewayAddress, e.device_time AS deviceTime,e.received_at AS occurredAt,e.clock_warning AS clockWarning, e.details_json AS details,CAST(e.message_id AS CHAR) AS messageId,'database' AS dataSource FROM fire_event e JOIN fire_gateway g ON e.gateway_id=g.gateway_id JOIN fire_place p ON p.place_id=g.place_id WHERE 1=1 AND e.event_id=#{id} AND e.event_kind=#{kind} ORDER BY e.received_at DESC,e.event_id DESC

SELECT CAST(m.message_id AS CHAR) AS id,m.session_id AS sessionId,m.peer_ip AS peerIp,m.direction,m.sequence_no AS sequenceNo,m.command_no AS commandNo, m.received_at AS receivedAt,m.device_time AS deviceTime,m.raw_hex AS rawHex,m.parse_status AS parseStatus, m.error_text AS error,m.transmission_status AS transmissionStatus,m.parsed_json AS parsed FROM fire_protocol_message m JOIN fire_gateway g ON m.gateway_id=g.gateway_id JOIN fire_place p ON p.place_id=g.place_id WHERE 1=1 ORDER BY m.message_id DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) AS hosts FROM fire_host h JOIN fire_gateway g ON h.gateway_id=g.gateway_id JOIN fire_place p ON p.place_id=g.place_id WHERE 1=1

SELECT COUNT(*) AS eventTotal,COALESCE(SUM(e.event_kind IN ('fire','manual_alarm')),0) AS fireEvents, COALESCE(SUM(e.event_kind='fault'),0) AS faultEvents FROM fire_event e JOIN fire_gateway g ON e.gateway_id=g.gateway_id JOIN fire_place p ON p.place_id=g.place_id WHERE e.received_at >= #{recentSince}

SELECT g.source_address AS sourceAddress,COUNT(*) AS total FROM fire_host h JOIN fire_gateway g ON h.gateway_id=g.gateway_id JOIN fire_place p ON p.place_id=g.place_id WHERE 1=1 GROUP BY g.source_address
mapper.update: UPDATE fire_protocol_message SET gateway_id=#{gatewayId} WHERE session_id=#{session} AND gateway_id IS NULL AND parse_status='RAW_CHUNK'
mapper.select: SELECT gateway_id FROM fire_protocol_message WHERE session_id=#{session} AND gateway_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY message_id DESC LIMIT 1
